title: Overthrow: America's Century of Regime Change from Hawaii to Iraq
publisher_or_archive: Times Books / Henry Holt and Company
summary: Authoritative historical study examining fourteen American-engineered overthrows of foreign governments from the 1893 Hawaiian Kingdom through Central American banana wars, Cold War covert operations (Iran, Guatemala, Congo, Chile, Vietnam), to the 2003 invasion of Iraq, detailing how short-term corporate and geopolitical goals consistently produced catastrophic long-term blowback.
